name: BuildHub
description: Offline parts search and AI-assisted BOM generation for electronics and 3D-printing (RepRap) builds. Crawls electronics/maker marketplaces and component distributors into a local, offline-searchable catalog; paste or AI-generate a parts list and get the cheapest source per line with links, using landed cost (unit price x MOQ + shipping), never unit price alone. Set BUILDHUB_ADMIN_TOKEN before exposing this beyond your LAN -- without it the admin pages (which mutate the catalog) refuse to serve from a non-loopback address, which every container connection is. AI BOM generation is optional and off by default -- set AI_PROVIDER to enable it with a cloud API key or a local Ollama instance. Requires --shm-size=1g (below in Extra Parameters) -- several adapters render pages in a real Chromium, and Docker's default 64MB /dev/shm makes that crash silently.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Database, media, browser profile and editable YAML config

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: Unraid's nobody user -- keeps appdata editable from the host

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Timezone the crawl schedule is interpreted in

variables.name: Mode
variables.description: serve = web UI + scheduler; web = UI only; schedule = crawler only

variables.name: Admin Token
variables.description: Required to reach /admin from a container. Any long random string; used as the HTTP Basic password.

variables.name: AI Provider
variables.description: Optional: none | anthropic | ollama. Enables AI-generated BOMs from a plain-language build description.

variables.name: AI API Key
variables.description: Only used when AI Provider = anthropic

variables.name: Ollama Base URL
variables.description: Only used when AI Provider = ollama. Point at a local/LAN Ollama instance.

variables.name: Translate Provider
variables.description: Optional: none | claude | deepl | google_free. Needed to merge non-English listings by title.

variables.name: Octopart Client ID
variables.description: Free Nexar key: https://nexar.com -- aggregates Mouser/Digi-Key/LCSC pricing by part number

variables.name: Mouser API Key
variables.description: Free key: https://www.mouser.com/api-hub/ -- direct Mouser search, alongside Octopart

variables.name: Digi-Key Client ID
variables.description: Requires an approved app: https://developer.digikey.com -- direct Digi-Key search, alongside Octopart

variables.name: eBay Client ID
variables.description: Optional -- without it the eBay baseline falls back to browser scraping
